start_here: Say to your AI: "Call the treg endpoint dataforseo.web.backlinks.summary for example.com, spend at most 5 cents." It runs tool:call-a-treg-endpoint with max_cost_usd 0.05 from your treg connection.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it sends one call to treg and spends from your prepaid treg balance, under the ceiling you name.
instructions: 1. Connect treg once (service_connection:treg holds your key; the key is never shown or placed in the input).
2. Find the endpoint with tool:search-the-treg-catalog and read its price with tool:read-a-treg-endpoint-and-its-price; say the price to the person.

3. Say to your AI: "Call <endpoint> with <inputs>, spend at most <dollars>". It calls tools:run with tool tool:call-a-treg-endpoint, account, endpoint, method (from the catalog), query or body, and max_cost_usd (required, above 0, at most 10).
4. Read the reply and its headers: x-treg-cost-micro (millionths of a dollar), x-treg-call-id (keep it). Tell the person the cost.
5. A 202 with _treg.outcome "pending" is a task still running: follow it with tool:read-a-treg-call and the call id; never call again.

worked_examples.title: A video task submitted, held at 50 cents and left to be followed
worked_examples.ask: Generate a short kite video with treg, spend at most a dollar.
worked_examples.given: From tools/treg/test/treg-rows.test.mjs (the stand-in treg test): POST https://treg.to/call/made-up.video.generate with X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost: 1 and the token in X-Treg-Token; the stand-in answers as treg does.
worked_examples.hands_back: Status 202 with {"_treg":{"outcome":"pending"},"reserved_micro":500000,"charged_micro":null}; headers x-treg-cost-micro 500000 (50 cents held, not yet charged), x-treg-call-id 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, x-treg-served-by made-up.video.generate and an x-treg-async descriptor. Follow it with tool:read-a-treg-call.
